name: hpo_to_adverse_terms (Bloom syndrome)
built_by: hand-written in step 11, experiment T1 (entry 156) by entry 152's method; every MedDRA id verified against OnSIDES v3.1.1 vocab_meddra_adverse_effect.csv (name and id agree) and confirmed on at least one label in product_adverse_effect.csv on 2026-09-25
method: Bloom syndrome's 42 aspect-P HPO terms (OMIM:210900, phenotype.hpoa 2026-09-02) read one by one against the MedDRA PTs OnSIDES uses: candidates by case-insensitive regex over vocab_meddra_adverse_effect.csv (patterns in entry 156), kept or dropped by hand. Tiers as entry 152: exact = the same event, class = a parent or sibling on the same axis. used_for_flag = no for congenital / structural features and pregnancy outcomes (a drug given after birth cannot cause them) and for terms with no label wording; every exclusion is a row with its reason.

sources.clinical: Bloom syndrome's public HPO annotation (OMIM:210900) - the case's clinical input; no patient
sources.genomic: none - this table is clinical only

inputs.name: GeneReviews Bloom syndrome (PMID 20301572)
inputs.role: names secondary malignancy and sun exposure as the risks to avoid

assumptions: a label adverse effect on the same axis as a disease feature is a potential collision for a person with that disease
limitations: no standard HPO-to-MedDRA mapping exists; manual judgement, reviewed by no clinician; several kept terms (Erythema, Upper respiratory tract infection, Interstitial lung disease, Diabetes mellitus) have high base rates, which the matched comparison set corrects for; no positive-control drug was fixed for this case
